[Unit]
Description=Minecraft Server Control Daemon
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=root
WorkingDirectory=/usr/local/bin
Environment="MCRCON_RCON_HOST=127.0.0.1"
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/minecraft-start.sh
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
